title: Specimen Handling Kits on Mobile In-Home Collection Trips
content:
## Specimen logistics schedule — Specimen Collection Appointments

A home trip carries a specimen handling-kit addition that depends on the service class of the order it collects, as the order's record in Laboratory Test Orders shows that class. The handling-kit addition is an amount added to the trip.

| Service class of the order collected | Handling-kit addition (USD) |
|---|---|
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 20.00 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 20.00 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 12.00 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 12.00 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 12.00 |
| Any other class (Routine Clinical Testing; Anatomic Pathology & Cytology) | None |

**Clause.** A trip collecting an order of the Esoteric Reference Testing or Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class carries a handling-kit addition of 20.00; a trip collecting an order of the Specialty Clinical Testing, Molecular Infectious Disease Testing or Clinical Toxicology Testing class carries a handling-kit addition of 12.00; a trip collecting an order of any other class carries none.

### Hypothetical readings

- A Mobile In-Home Collection Visit collecting a Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing order: addition 20.00.
- A visit collecting a Clinical Toxicology Testing order: addition 12.00.
- A visit collecting a Routine Clinical Testing order: no addition.

The class is that of the order the visit collects — the order named on the visit — not of any other order the patient holds.
